text:
maria: Heads-up — our Next.js starter (app dir) + LangChain sample is flaking in the eval harness.

maria: Repro: 1) yarn dev, 2) open /api/chat (SSR route), 3) run ./scripts/eval_run.sh -> ~30% of runs 401 then retry flood.

devon: Any stack traces? logs?

maria: Logs show: `auth middleware` sees no token on edge SSR. We set token via COOKIE in client; on server components cookie isn't forwarded to our internal fetch when using Edge runtime. Retry middleware kicks in and spawns a second request -> cascade.

chris: Hmm. Is this the same as the old "cookie vs header" issue? Could be fetch location. Can you paste the route handler?

maria: Paste:

```
export async function POST(req) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const resp = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL + '/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  return NextResponse.json(await resp.json());
}
```

maria: Note: no Authorization header — relying on cookies and internal proxy token. Works in node runtime but edge drops the cookie.

samira: dx-parity note: our SDK expects server -> to use `serverAuth()` helper which injects header. Starter uses a raw fetch. That's probably the mismatch.

devon: Quick workaround: add header using secret: `headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + process.env.INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN }` — but that's a security smell for sample app.

chris: Could we update starter to call `import { serverAuth } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` in server routes and use that to decorate requests? Safer and shows proper pattern.

maria: I'll open a tiny PR in sample repo with a patch and a reproducer test for the eval harness. It will also add a note in README about edge runtime cookie behavior.

dx-bot: New issue created: INF-3456 — "next-starter: edge SSR cookie->auth mismatch causing eval retries" (link: https://git.redwood/INF-3456)

samira: Great. Could we also add an eval job variant that runs in edge runtime to catch this in CI?

devon: +1. I can add a CI matrix entry and a small harness script.

chris: Assign to maria + devon? @maria @devon :thumbsup: 

maria: assigned and PR soon. thanks!

maria: tl;dr: starter uses raw fetch in app dir server route -> edge runtime loses cookie -> 401 -> retry flood in eval harness. Fix: use serverAuth helper or explicit header, document behavior.

chris: Nice writeup. This will help prevent onboarding friction for new users. :raised_hands:
